race.comment: LA CHAPARRON (7) finally got a win on the board. She sat midfield in a small field and rounded them up late. Gets another furlong for this and a nice barrier so has a lot of things in her favour. Once they break through, they often put a couple together. TUCKLAN (9) is a little the same. However, she led all the way at Narromine and put a margin in them. As long as she can run the trip, she will be in the finish. SMART SCUD (2) comes from a strong yard and will be fitter now third up. Has not been that far away each time. Easy to see improvement coming. SWIFT GUN (3) went better second up and now gets to a more suitable journey.
